spec.title: OpenWrt - Clients
spec.description: Client inventory dashboard for OpenWrt identity, bounded conntrack occupancy, MAC-keyed nlbwmon traffic accounting, and Loki-first WiFi roaming detail.

options.content:
## Client inventory
Unified client identity from the OpenWrt clients profile. Missing collectors and unavailable joins are rendered explicitly instead of as zeros.

spec.title: Inventory Collector
spec.description: Collector availability gated by both the client inventory flag and the Lua exporter's per-collector scrape success.

spec.expr: (max(openwrt_client_inventory_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) * max(node_scrape_collector_success{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", collector="client_inventory"})) or vector(0)

spec.title: Clients
spec.description: One current identity series per discovered client.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: WiFi Clients
spec.description: Clients currently associated to a WiFi interface according to the clients profile.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection="wifi", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Inventory Truncation
spec.description: If this is truncated, the router hit CLIENT_INVENTORY_MAX and client rows are incomplete.

spec.expr: max(openwrt_client_inventory_truncated{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Flow Offload
spec.description: When software or hardware flow offload is enabled, nftables and conntrack traffic accounting can under-report or read near zero.

spec.expr: max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Conntrack Entries
spec.description: Current per-client conntrack-table occupancy is suppressed while flow-offload entry semantics remain unverified on this router. This is a state count, not conntrack byte accounting.

spec.expr: ((((max(openwrt_client_conntrack_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0)) == 1) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)) * 0 + 1) or ((max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1) * 0 + 2) or vector(0)

spec.title: Connection Split
spec.description: Client count by connection type. Unknown is an explicit state from the collector, not a dashboard error.

spec.expr: count by(connection) (openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Clients by Network
spec.description: Client count by logical OpenWrt network label from the clients profile.

spec.expr: count by(network) (openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Clients by SSID
spec.description: Associated WiFi clients by SSID and band. Wired clients intentionally do not appear here.

spec.expr: topk(10, count by(ssid, band) (openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", ssid!=""}))

options.content:
## Traffic accounting
Per-client traffic is keyed directly by MAC from nlbwmon. When software or hardware flow offload is enabled, every nlbwmon traffic panel suppresses its values and the accounting state reports unreliable rather than displaying plausible zeros.

spec.title: Client Inventory
spec.description: One row per openwrt_client_info client. Traffic is nlbwmon per-MAC accounting; the state column is explicit when collection is absent or flow offload makes conntrack accounting unreliable.

spec.expr: openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}
openwrt_client_up{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}
openwrt_client_lease_expiry_seconds{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"} - time()
openwrt_client_ipv6_addresses{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}

(sum by(mac) (rate(openwrt_client_bytes_total{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", direction="in"}[$__rate_interval]))) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)

(sum by(mac) (rate(openwrt_client_bytes_total{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", direction="out"}[$__rate_interval]))) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)

openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"} * 0 + on() group_left() (((((max(openwrt_client_traffic_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0)) == 1) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)) * 0 + 1) or ((max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1) * 0 + 2) or vector(0))
(openwrt_client_conntrack_entries{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)

spec.title: Client Presence
spec.description: Online and offline client inventory trend. Offline clients still appear in the inventory when the router knows about them.

spec.expr: sum(openwrt_client_up{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"} * on(mac) group_left(connection, network) openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"})

count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}) - sum(openwrt_client_up{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"} * on(mac) group_left(connection, network) openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"})

spec.title: Randomized / Local MACs
spec.description: Locally administered MACs are privacy/randomized or synthetic addresses; the dashboard surfaces them without trying to fingerprint a physical device.

spec.expr: count by(mac_type) (openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Highest Conntrack Occupancy
spec.description: Current conntrack rows containing each known client IPv4 address. This is a bounded per-client state count; it is suppressed while flow-offload entry semantics remain unverified.

spec.expr: (topk(12, openwrt_client_conntrack_entries{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"} * on(mac) group_left(hostname, network) openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"})) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)

options.content:
## Per-client traffic
nlbwmon accounts traffic by MAC and a deliberately small service set. The counters reset at nlbwmon accounting-period rollover, which `rate()` and `increase()` handle normally. Flow offload is a hard correctness guard: when enabled, all traffic values below are suppressed and the accounting state is red.

spec.title: Traffic Accounting State
spec.description: Not collected means nlbwmon is unavailable. Accounting unreliable means software or hardware flow offload is enabled, so all M6 traffic panels suppress values rather than showing wrong zeros.

spec.expr: ((((max(openwrt_client_traffic_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0)) == 1) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)) * 0 + 1) or ((max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1) * 0 + 2) or vector(0)

spec.title: Traffic Collector
spec.description: Availability of the nlbwmon textfile collector. A failed schema or unsupported service is fail-closed.

spec.expr: (max(openwrt_client_traffic_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0))

spec.title: Flow Offload
spec.description: Software or hardware flow offload makes conntrack-derived nlbwmon accounting unreliable.

spec.expr: max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Inbound by Client
spec.description: Per-MAC nlbwmon inbound rate. Suppressed when flow offload is enabled.

spec.expr: topk(12, (sum by(mac) (rate(openwrt_client_bytes_total{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", direction="in"}[$__rate_interval]))) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1))

spec.title: Outbound by Client
spec.description: Per-MAC nlbwmon outbound rate. Suppressed when flow offload is enabled.

spec.expr: topk(12, (sum by(mac) (rate(openwrt_client_bytes_total{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", direction="out"}[$__rate_interval]))) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1))

spec.title: Traffic by Service
spec.description: Bounded service buckets from the installed nlbwmon protocol file. Suppressed when flow offload is enabled.

spec.expr: (sum by(service, direction) (rate(openwrt_client_bytes_total{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}[$__rate_interval]))) unless on() (max(openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) == 1)

options.content:
## Data quality
Collector state, joinability, and identity gaps are surfaced as first-class values. A missing join or collector is not treated as a healthy zero.

spec.title: Collector Availability
spec.description: Raw availability and offload-state series needed to trust or reject the client dashboard values.

spec.expr: openwrt_client_inventory_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}
node_scrape_collector_success{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", collector="client_inventory"}
openwrt_client_inventory_truncated{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}
openwrt_flow_offload_enabled{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}

spec.title: No Hostname
spec.description: Clients without a usable hostname remain visible in the inventory and retain MAC-keyed nlbwmon traffic accounting.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", hostname=~"unknown_.*"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Randomized / Local
spec.description: Clients using a locally administered MAC address. This includes privacy-randomized and synthetic addresses.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", mac_type="local"}) or vector(0)

spec.title: Missing IP
spec.description: Inventory rows without an IPv4 address. This should remain low and explicit.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", ip=""}) or vector(0)

spec.title: WiFi Missing SSID
spec.description: WiFi clients whose association data is missing an SSID.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection="wifi", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", ssid=""}) or vector(0)

spec.title: WiFi Missing Band
spec.description: WiFi clients whose association data is missing a radio band.

spec.expr: count(openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection="wifi", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", band=""}) or vector(0)

spec.title: No Signal Join
spec.description: Associated WiFi clients without a matching signal sample after MAC-case normalization.

spec.title: IPv6 Address Count
spec.description: IPv6 presence is counted, not exposed as address labels, avoiding privacy-address churn.

spec.expr: openwrt_client_ipv6_addresses{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"} * on(mac) group_left(hostname) openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac"}

spec.title: Local MAC Clients
spec.description: Clients flagged by mac_type=local. This replaces OUI/vendor lookup and avoids fingerprinting randomised addresses.

spec.expr: openwrt_client_info{job="openwrt", router=~"$router", connection=~"$connection", network=~"$network", mac=~"$mac", mac_type="local"}

options.content:
## WiFi roaming
Raw hostapd association and disconnection lines are kept in Loki for per-client investigation. Prometheus receives only the bounded aggregate counter by AP, SSID, and event; it never carries a MAC, remote IP, domain, port, IPv6 address, or vendor label.

spec.title: Association Event Collector
spec.description: Availability of the bounded AP/SSID/event counter. Loki raw-event panels remain useful even when this aggregate counter is unavailable.

spec.expr: (max(openwrt_wifi_assoc_events_collector_available{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}) or vector(0))

spec.title: Roam Events (1h)
spec.description: Hostapd association/disconnection lines in Loki. A zero is a valid no-events state on a single AP; an empty Loki result is rendered as zero, not an error.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="openwrt-syslog", router=~"$router"} |~ "AP-STA-(CONNECTED|DISCONNECTED)" [1h])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Association Events by AP / SSID
spec.description: Bounded aggregate association events. The label budget is AP x SSID x {connected, disconnected}; no MAC label is emitted.

spec.expr: sum by(ap, ssid, event) (increase(openwrt_wifi_assoc_events_total{job="openwrt", router=~"$router"}[$__rate_interval]))
